assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code CO-197.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
Dizziness and giddiness is coded as R42.
The patient has an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded as I49.9.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction is coded as Z86.73.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes.
The denial applies to a specific episode of care being appealed.
The appellant requests review and reprocessing of the claim.
